## Featured Projects

- [SmartMess](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/smartmess): Comprehensive hostel mess management platform with real-time menu visibility, digital attendance, a student feedback & rating system, complaint portal, and an admin analytics dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT.
- [Dev Portfolio Admin Panel](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/dev-portfolio-admin-panel): Blazing-fast admin panel for managing portfolio backend data — contact messages, newsletter subscriptions — with JWT auth, smart filtering, full CRUD operations, and a professional analytics dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT.
- [Real-Time Chat App](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/real-time-chat-app): Full-stack chat application with JWT authentication, Socket.IO for real-time messaging, online/offline status, and Cloudinary image uploads. Features modern UI with theme customization. Built with React, Node.js, Socket.IO, MongoDB, JWT.
- [BuildMyTeam](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/buildmyteam): Production-oriented collaboration platform for colleges to manage hackathons, team formation, join requests, and team workspaces with secure role-based access. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT.
- [FocusGuard](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/focusguard): AI-powered real-time attention monitor that detects sustained phone-looking behavior from webcam input and triggers alerts to reduce distraction and mindless scrolling. Built with Python, OpenCV, YOLOv4-tiny, NumPy, Computer Vision.
- [TrueCert](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/truecert): Secure digital certificate issuance and verification platform with QR-based public validation, tamper detection, analytics, and issuer dashboard workflows. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT.
- [Fire Detection Alert System](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/fire-detection-alert-system): Real-time computer-vision fire detection pipeline that analyzes webcam streams and triggers instant audio alerts using multi-stage confirmation logic. Built with Python, OpenCV, NumPy, Pygame, pyttsx3.
- [ZipLink](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/ziplink): A full-stack URL shortener project built with Flask, SQLite, Tailwind CSS, and Jinja2. Automatically generates collision-resistant short codes, redirects users to target destinations, and tracks click counts via a unified dashboard. Built with Python, Flask, SQLite, Tailwind CSS, Jinja2.
- [InstaX](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/instax): High-performance social media platform built using Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, Neon PostgreSQL, Clerk OAuth, and UploadThing edge storage. Features optimistic client updates, drag-and-drop media uploads, and real-time-like notifications. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma.
- [RAG-Based AI Teaching Assistant](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/rag-ai-teaching-assistant): A high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system built specifically for video course lecture processing. Turns long video lectures into an intelligent, queryable AI knowledge base delivering grounded explanations with exact video numbers, titles, and precise timestamps (MM:SS). Built with Python, OpenAI Whisper, Google Gemini API, Ollama, Scikit-Learn.
- [LinkedIn Clone (MERN Stack)](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/mern-linkedin-clone): Comprehensive professional networking platform built with the MERN stack. Features secure JWT authentication, user profile setup, connection requests, rich feed posts with image attachments, real-time Socket.io notifications, Mailtrap email delivery, Zod schema validation, AWS S3 image storage, and analytics tracking. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose.
- [Spotify Clone](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/spotify-clone): Full-featured audio streaming and social music platform built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, Cloudinary CDN, and Redux. Includes custom audio playback controls, queue management, live multi-user listening activity tracking, built-in real-time chat, and an admin analytics dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose.
- [Kanoon-Mate AI Legal Assistance Platform](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/kanoon-mate): An end-to-end, production-ready legal AI platform designed to break down legal barriers for Indian citizens. Features Multi-Format OCR, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash AI, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) law mapping, Voice Dictation/Read-Aloud, Automated Deadline Tracking, and Emergency Legal Helpline Hub. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Google Gemini API.
- [Smart LMS (SaaS Platform)](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/smart-lms): Full-stack SaaS Learning Management System built with React, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Google OAuth 2.0, Razorpay payment gateway, and Gemini AI-powered smart search. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express.
- [InsightAudio](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/insightaudio): Autonomous AI Meeting Assistant & Video Intelligence Platform. Converts YouTube links and local media recordings into structured executive summaries, actionable task trackers, and conversational RAG memory — 100% self-hosted, private, and cost-free. Built with Python, Streamlit, OpenAI Whisper, Sarvam AI API, LangChain.
